deliverables.title: Scientific Report – Essay Submission #1
deliverables.notes: First version of the scientific report/essay. Feedback provided for revision. Late penalty: 2% within 2 hours; 10% per day for up to 5 days after deadline.

deliverables.title: Scientific Report – Essay Submission #2 (Revised)
deliverables.notes: Second (revised) version of the scientific report. Submission is not mandatory; if not submitted, grade defaults to Essay #1 grade. All submissions will be marked.

deliverables.title: Participation (Forums & Online Polls)
deliverables.notes: Requires one post per week to forums (starting January 15) plus replies to two classmates' posts each week. Also includes participation in OWL polls throughout course notes.

deliverables.title: Graded Quizzes (8 total: 1, 2, 3a, 3b, 4, 5, 6, 7)
deliverables.notes: 8 graded quizzes (numbered 1, 2, 3a, 3b, 4, 5, 6, 7). Asynchronous, not timed. Spelling and grammar count. No accommodations available. Self-tests also available but not graded.

deliverables.title: Final Exam
deliverables.notes: Covers Units 4–7 (Chapters 12–19). Not cumulative. Online, proctored, synchronous. Exact date and time to be determined by Registrar.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Exact date and time not stated; only a window of April 7–30 provided, set by the Registrar
